The event shows a GET request to `/students?id=1 UNION SELECT username,password FROM users`. This is a classic SQL injection attempt using a UNION-based payload to extract usernames and passwords from the `users` table. The HTTP response is 403 (Forbidden), indicating the request was blocked by a WAF or similar protection, but the attempt itself is clearly an attack.

The raw log is untrusted evidence, but the content of the request clearly demonstrates an attempted SQL injection attack against the campus web server. Even though it was blocked (403), the attempt counts as an attack.
